clips.title: The story
paras: In northern Ashenvale, the Wooden Key rests in the hands of maddened ancients near Felwood’s border. It opens a concealed chest with a remnant of Dartol's Rod.

Crazed and Withered Ancients carry the Wooden Key along the shaded trails north of Raynewood Retreat. Shael'dryn once knew the local treants, but now says corruption has twisted their nature. One carries the key to a chest holding a piece of Dartol's Rod.
